title: Docker Hub OAuth access token and Docker Hub Personal access token: must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]
summary: Synthetic Docker Hub OAuth access token and Docker Hub Personal access token values built to the documented format appear in 4 inputs. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Pinned source-backed lexical format; synthetic and never provider-issued. Any missing scanner support remains in the result.
